trial: B2 only; 1.5 x ATR20; integer MNQ sizing to $1,000 nominal stop risk
hypothesis: Volatility-scaled protective stops may reduce premature stop-outs without changing 50-bar breakouts or next-30m-open exits.
falsifier: Native cost-aware result is non-positive per nominal R or intended stop/entry/accounting invariants fail; no optimization follows.

bar_and_feature.bar: 30m, 17:00 America/Chicago session anchored, only exactly 30 distinct source minutes qualify
bar_and_feature.atr: ml4t.engineer.compute_features ATR period=20; standard True Range; TA-Lib-compatible Wilder smoothing verified against library output
bar_and_feature.decision_availability: Feature computed from completed bar and released on its final one-minute row; order is NEXT_BAR and therefore first eligible on following source row.
bar_and_feature.stop: ceil(1.5 * ATR20 / 0.25) * 0.25 points, protective trigger from actual filled entry price; native stop fill mode retained from baseline and gap behavior audited.

unchanged_entry_exit.entries: buy STOP at previous 50 complete highs; sell STOP at previous 50 complete lows; intended OCO
unchanged_entry_exit.exit: market order submitted on prior available minute for immediately next 30m boundary opening print; missing opening print may delay to next source event
unchanged_entry_exit.daily_cap: 2 filled entry contracts/orders per Chicago session day
